name: CK SAN-ETSU Co.,Ltd.
summary: CK SAN-ETSU Co., Ltd. was established in Takaoka in 1919 and makes and distributes brass rod and wire in Japan, China and Taiwan. It also produces precision forged and cut parts, CK-branded piping equipment and hot-dip galvanized metal goods. It was formerly SAN-ETSU METALS Co., Ltd. and changed its name in October 2011.
